throughline.zh: 半導體與伺服器供應鏈公布營運及投資進度，南亞與三井金屬宣布材料廠擴充，馬來西亞則研議新增資料中心晶片監管。
throughline.en: Semiconductor and server companies reported operating and investment developments, Nanya and Mitsui announced materials capacity plans, and Malaysia considered new data-center chip monitoring rules.

title.zh: 半導體封測設備、晶圓材料與新產能計畫
title.en: Semiconductor testing, wafer materials and new manufacturing plans

summary.zh: 本週台積電、日月光及多家晶圓測試與設備業者陸續公告財務、封裝與設備驗收進度。11 月 11 至 12 日三福化核准橋頭科學園區化學品新廠、漢測揭露股權費用及誠美材公布切割膠帶送驗計畫，分別屬資本支出、已認列財務與未完成的客戶認證。
summary.en: TSMC, ASEH and wafer-test suppliers reported results, packaging activity and equipment milestones. San Fu approved a Qiaotou chemical factory, Hermes disclosed an equity-compensation charge and Cheng Mei described packaging-tape qualification. These represent approved capital, recognized accounting and prospective acceptance.

title.zh: 工業電源、電子基板材料與海外製造
title.en: Industrial power, substrate materials and overseas manufacturing

summary.zh: 中鋼、台達電、光寶科與國巨披露電源及零組件進度，台灣機械業另公布出口數據。南亞核准彰濱玻纖布廠、三井金屬公布馬來西亞銅箔新廠，雙鴻揭露散熱財報，立凱電與北美業者簽 LFP 合作備忘錄，材料規劃、實際營收與合作意向分別標示。
summary.en: China Steel, Delta, Lite-On and Yageo reported power-related activity alongside Taiwanese machinery exports. Nanya approved a fiberglass plant, Mitsui proposed a Malaysian copper-foil facility, Auras reported cooling results and Aleees signed an LFP memorandum. Planned materials capacity, realized sales and nonbinding cooperation are kept separate.

title.zh: 資料中心政策、機房建設與伺服器系統
title.en: Data-center policy, infrastructure and server systems

summary.zh: 馬來西亞與印尼的機房工程及供水問題仍有未確認事項，台灣 ODM 業者公布多項伺服器財報與擴廠案。鴻海 11 月 12 日公布第三季實績，馬來西亞則提出資料中心 GPU 申報立法構想；新增規範尚未生效，伺服器出貨預測也未提供獨立機櫃數量。
summary.en: Malaysian and Indonesian data-center developments retain unresolved construction and water questions, while Taiwanese ODMs released server results and factory plans. Foxconn reported Q3 results on November 12 and Malaysia outlined a possible GPU reporting law, with no enacted new rule or verified rack counts.

title.zh: 記憶體技術、成熟製程與合約價格預測
title.en: Memory technology, mature-node production and contract-price forecasts

summary.zh: 台積電先前重申專業晶圓代工定位，華邦電說明既有擴建預算，來頡揭露成熟製程與封測成本預期。TrendForce 對 PC DRAM 及 Client SSD 的第四季合約價區間是研究預測，未涵蓋每一家廠商已成交的實際價格。
summary.en: TSMC reiterated its foundry focus, Winbond discussed prior expansion budgets and M3 described mature-node and back-end cost pressure. TrendForce's PC DRAM and client SSD Q4 contract-price ranges are forecasts rather than executed prices for individual suppliers.

title.zh: electronica 與 SEMICON Europa 臺灣供應商參展
title.en: Taiwanese suppliers at electronica and SEMICON Europa

summary.zh: 外貿協會列出超過 250 家臺灣供應商參與 11 月 10 至 13 日慕尼黑 electronica 展會及相關活動，SEMICON Europa 同期舉行。主辦單位公布的展期與展商資料可核對，尚未有可驗證的現場採購金額。
summary.en: TAITRA listed more than 250 Taiwanese participants at electronica in Munich on November 10–13, alongside SEMICON Europa. Dates and exhibitor participation were published, but no verifiable signed order values were provided.
